svg.aria-label: Shourya Upadhyaya: Backend-leaning full-stack developer, CSE @ VIT Vellore ('28). I build production backends with Node.js, PostgreSQL/MongoDB and Redis, ship them in Docker, and monitor them with Prometheus + Grafana. Open to SDE internships.
